# Spray Medications
These medications are applied via spray bottle (or backpack water tank) to apply their effects. [bold]They work on the dead![/bold]
[bold]Medicinal sprays can't affect people through hardsuits![/bold] (They also can't affect animals...)
Note that the effects listed in the guidebook aren't necessarily what's applied.
## Brute Styptic Powder is fantastic at healing severe brute wounds, stitching up 6 Blunt, 6 Slash, and 3 Piercing damage per unit sprayed. It also significantly reduces bleeding!
5 Styptic Crystal Catalyst + 10 Blood + 10 Sodium --> 1 styptic crystal shard
## Burn Silver Sulfadiazine heals all sorts of burn wounds, repairing 4.5 Heat, 4.5 Cold, 3 Shock, and 3 Caustic damage per unit sprayed.
## Toxin
Synthcells is an option to cure Toxin damage on the dead, healing per unit sprayed 6 Poison and 3 Radiation damage in exchange for inflicting about 0.75 Blunt damage.
Synthflesh cures Brute and Burn at 1/4 the effectiveness of Styptic Powder and Silver Sulfadiazine per unit sprayed.
10 Carbon + 10 Blood + 10 Phenol + 10 Sodium Polyacrylate --> 1 synth meat + 5 Hydroxide
